On an auspicious occasion on 22nd day of August 1996, Agia College came into existence as a Degree (Arts) College as a result of maiden effort of the people of greater Agia locality, under the Presidentship of Sri Mahesh Ch. Nath, Secretaryship of Late Swahid Ray and Principalship of Late Dr. Monoj Kumar Chakraborty with five lecturers and twenty-nine students. The dream of a Degree College at Agia under Balijana revenue Circle of Goalpara District (Assam) has fulfilled under the leadership of these venerable persons with the wholehearted help and support of the locality.
With the throb of time, the College celebrating the Silver Jubilee year and emerging as a centre of quality education. As per the need of the locality in general and students in particular, the College has been trying its level best to focus on its mission, vision, goal and objectives to facilitate the students with new avenues to cope with the challenges of the hour.
The first batch of student appeared B.A. final examination in the year 1999, and a marked number of students have completed their undergraduate course in Arts from this College till date. The Alumni of the College rendering their valuable services to the nation in various field and flourish the glory of the institution. College fraternity as a whole committed to place the institution as one of the premier as well as a remarkable higher educational institution of the region.
Welcome to Agia College

All
                                    News
Profound and untiring hunt of the visionaries of the locality for an institution of higher education at Agia placed in reality on 22nd August of 1996 in the name of AGIA COLLEGE. The unceasing and worthy effort of the Managing Committee & Governing Body towards a positive direction, the College has a step for all-round progress to cater the spark of higher education to the locality of the vast rural backward area belonging to the inhabited of Schedule Caste, Schedule Tribe, Other Backward Class, More Other Backward Class and General community.
As a centre of co-education, the College has been offering the Three Year Degree Classes in Arts stream with Honours Course (earlier known as Major course) in Assamese, Education, Economics and Political Science and Regular Course (earlier known as General Course) in Assamese, English, Education, Economics, History and Political Science along with the compulsory course like Environmental Studies. Gradually, College will go for opening the Honours Course in English and History as well as to open new Regular courses based on the demand of the era.
The College is Permanently Affiliated to Gauhati University and Provincialised by Govt of Assam. It is also registered under the Society Act.
Active co-operation of faculty members, Non-teaching staff, Students’ Union, Alumni Association and right time support of the Governing Body has uplifting the College to extend the tidal wave of education among the aspirants of the grater locality of Agia. With the collective efforts from every corner, by following its mission, vision, goals and objectives, the College has been making a noble effort to place the College as the centre of excellence.
On behalf of the greater Agia College community, I welcome the students who desire to admit themselves to be the part of Agia College community and to make them proper.
From The Principal's Desk
Dr. Utpal Das

Legal Definition of Ragging
                                'Ragging' means the doing of any act which causes, or is likely to cause any physical,
                                psychological or physiological harm of apprehension or shame or embarrassment to a student,
                                and includes
                                (a) Teasing or abusing of playing Practical joke on, or causing hurt to any student.
                                (b) Asking any student to do any act, or perform anything, which he/she would not, in the
                                ordinary course, be willing to do or perform.
                                Ragging is different from other crimes because the motive is solely to get perverse
                                pleasure. Ragging is also different from other crimes as certain sections of society
                                actively promote it.
